# E0304: what a lens produces is not an instance of its target schema

This condition cannot arise when thema's checker is sound: every lens is proven total at bind, and the proof names the mapping at fault (E0360 to E0372) before this check runs.

If thema reports it, the bug is in thema, not in the lineage or the data.
Please report it at https://github.com/sdboyer/thema/issues with the lineage
and, for a translation, the instance.
